switch_show_roleslist.description: Turn the public role list of the project on or off: when it is on, the project applications and characters are visible to everyone, including logged-out visitors. Every call flips the setting.

get_roles_list.description: Get the project role list — by group, by plot or for the whole project at once. Changes nothing. Used by the embeddable widget on external sites and by the Excel export.

params.obj_type: Breakdown of the list: group — by group, plot — by plot, character — by character
params.obj_id: ID of the object of the chosen breakdown, or all for every object of that type in the project
params.command: Widget command; create builds the list
params.project_id: ID of the project whose roles are requested
params.excel: 1 returns the list as an Excel export instead of HTML
